turns.question: Of the partner outreach messages we sent from 1 to 3 October 2026, what share got an answer within 12 hours?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no 12-hour reply metric; its one definition is the reply rate, the share of outreach messages that got a reply at any time, which was 66.7 % for messages sent 1 to 3 October 2026 (the closest metrics are reply_rate, messages_replied and messages_sent). Late: partner_outreach.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
